sample_policy.rule: All V1/V2 performance metrics use the intersection of stocks evaluable by both versions.
sample_policy.investment_return_rule: Average investment return uses the subset where both V1 and V2 have a non-neutral direction.
sample_policy.market_benchmark: Equal-weight average return of the same common sample.

definition.scope: Only stocks evaluable by both V1 and V2 are compared.
definition.actual_class: 上漲: return > 0.3%; 下跌: return < -0.3%; 中性: |return| <= 0.3%.
definition.hit: Predicted direction class exactly equals the actual class.
definition.closer: On direction-changed rows, smaller ordinal distance between predicted class (-1/0/+1) and actual class wins.
definition.caveat: All performance comparisons use only the intersection of stocks evaluable by both versions. Version-only stocks are retained only for stock-list views.
